quote: More flexible f-string parsing, allowing many things previously disallowed … Even more improved error messages.
In Python 3.10 and 3.11, distutils will be formally marked as deprecated.
note: The removal is right (the PEP says "Code that imports distutils will no longer work from Python 3.12"), but it was deprecated in Python 3.10, not 3.8.

quote: delivering an estimated 5% overall performance improvement
note: The release page says about 5%, not 25%.

quote: CPython now has experimental support for running in a free-threaded mode, with the global interpreter lock (GIL) disabled. … This is an experimental feature and therefore is not enabled by default.
note: Overstated: running without the GIL is experimental and off by default, not the default.
